answer.reason: The verses show Joah going out with Eliakim and Shebna to meet Rabshakeh and then reporting his words to Hezekiah.

clauses.english: went out with Eliakim and Shebna to meet Rabshakeh and asked him to speak in the Syrian language
clauses.quote: Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language

clauses.english: came to Hezekiah with his clothes rent and told him Rabshakeh's words
clauses.quote: to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh
